control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at PSV-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7102 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-7102 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-7102 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during routine operation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 6 April 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during routine operation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
